failurePaths.qualification: Active ownership blocks independent review. Stale bytes deny retirement. Explicit acknowledgment preserves payload.
Closed requests reject unknown fields and invalid IDs. Malformed checkpoints block launch. No automatic deletion of partial or malformed metadata.
Launch and cancellation have one winner. Admitted setup failures and cancellation races finalize.
Ownership survives cleanup finalization. Preserve payload without automatic retry or replay.
Persistence failure blocks later effects. Exclusive durable writes do not launch.
Retain ownership through finalization. Ambiguous launch stays active for explicit review.
Owned child fixtures verify handle release and preservation of checkpoint or payload bytes.
Expiry, replay, cancellation, foreign schema or paths and restart markers deny admission in the tested scenarios.
Existing plan expiry and no replay only. No new vendor process timeout evidence.
Recovery failure publishes no replacement. Restart status remains review-only.
